title: WHAT
WE BUILD.
hero.intro: Three kinds of production work, plus custom. Fixed scope. Shipped.

cta.title: READY WHEN IT NEEDS TO SHIP.

cards.title: PREDICTION
cards.description: You have data. You need a call: rank, flag, forecast, route. We build the path from ingest to a screen and the alerts around it. Dashboards, scoring services, internal tools. If nobody on your team would open it twice, it is not done.

cards.title: VOICE
cards.description: You need a product or an internal tool that listens and replies. We build the speech loop: capture, transcribe, decide, speak or act. Built for noisy audio and mixed language, not studio-mic English. You leave with a working interface, not a slide about agents.

cards.title: INDUSTRIAL
cards.description: The model is the easy part. The system around it is not. We build pipelines, adapters, and runtime glue so the thing that worked in a notebook still works on Monday. Logging, jobs, handoffs, the unglamorous path to it stayed up.

cards.title: CUSTOM
cards.description: Brand, product, motion, a tool that is only yours. Same rule: one problem, one scope, one ship. If we cannot name the artifact in a sentence, we do not start.

sections.title: HOW ENGAGEMENTS WORK.
sections.body: You bring the constraint. We map what is real, cut what is theater, build, and ship. Work is scoped as a fixed build. Past client work stays under NDA. If you are in one of these areas, talk to us.
